name: Prompt bar generate
looks: A minimal, rounded prompt bar sits alone on an open field. A short phrase types on into it character by character with a blinking cursor, then a round submit button presses and springs back. A generated result pops up below or beside the bar, soft-focus to sharp, with a small labelled chip naming the style or mode used.
build: DOM text revealed per character (kit.typeOn), one voice, in a glowing pill; the submit button scales 1 -> 0.88 -> 1 on power3.out; the result pops at scale 0.92 -> 1 with blur(6px) -> blur(0) over 0.2-0.3s right after the press; the chip fades/slides up 4-6px after.
sound: A soft key tick per character, a click on the press, and a light pop as the result resolves.
prompt: Type a short phrase into a minimal prompt bar, press submit with a quick spring, and let a generated result pop up sharpened from a soft blur with a small chip naming what was used. Keep the phrase short and the result honestly generic, not a real brand's output.
